rules: Use the user-preferred Korean heading intensity (gangdo) instead of segi in exercise descriptions.
Before user review, research biomechanics/evidence and apply necessary corrections within authorized scope; explain changes and evidence limits.
Review placement and redundancy: concrete execution and safety cues in how-to; purpose and reasons in why. Apply suitable corrections and show them.

Use direct evidence to state supported facts and effects with appropriate confidence and scope; when evidence is indirect or insufficient, describe the training purpose and potential contribution without claiming established performance benefit. Report errors or evidence gaps in user directions.

Check user-requested changes against biomechanics and research; report scientific errors or weak evidence, distinguish related exercise evidence from direct pitching transfer. Add paragraph breaks as appropriate.
User clarified that proposed corrections should be applied immediately, including title. Show results; next only after user direction.
Current workflow overrides notes-only history: user direction → concretize → immediately apply authorized title/description/feasible owned-video edits → show result for human check.
Explain evidence-based edit/content/title candidates before the user decides; do not silently apply unrequested new candidates.
Next video only on clear user okay/next. Explicit restart at #1 authorized; retain historical first-pass judgments.

Owned-video editing is authorized when user specifies desired changes; distinguish actual edit, source availability, revised preview, replacement and re-shoot. Never fabricate a real hold by freezing frames.
Preserve automatic filming-needed tracking and country-specific legal/rights unresolved issues.
Keep necessary applied-result handoff for cross-computer resume; do not substitute a pending note for an authorized edit.
No code/player/schema/deployment expansion. Common player belongs to Sub1; use supported library entry when supplied.

Always write how-to instructions for someone performing the exercise for the first time: use plain concrete language and consistent numbered preparation, movement, return and safety cues; maintain accurate video-specific technique and previous user decisions.

User requires the same equipment to be called by the same clear name in all exercise descriptions: use 케이블 머신 rather than 기계, 메디신볼 for medicine balls, 랜드마인 고정 장치 for landmine anchor; distinguish genuinely different equipment and use accessible language. Apply as subsequent exercises are reviewed.

For relevant lead-leg actions use understandable consistent lead-foot ground pressure and controlled forward motion; springing is an analogy. Distinguish each drill and actual video, allow pelvic rotation/normal movement and avoid forced knee lock; pitching data does not prove transfer of the particular drill.
playback_rule: Latest user instruction: on the shared player check repeat is enabled; do not wait for full playback or an actual repeat cycle. Independently inspect footage as needed for content review. Move on only with user instruction.
title_rule: Match original title meaning and actual variation; now apply user-directed changes immediately and verify saved result.
research_rule: Research biomechanics and relevant evidence for each exercise, make necessary corrections before user review, explain sources and limits, and evaluate user-requested revisions for scientific accuracy.
research_coverage_caution: 학술근거 절차는5번부터 강화.1~4번의 운동별 직접 학술 검토 완료를 소급 주장하지 않음. 이전 current가 덮어써져 과거 GPT 후보/원문 전체가 JSON에 남지 않은 것은 대화 복원 또는 미보존으로 표시. Current batch rechecked general plyometric/push-up, bench-load, unilateral and ball-throw biomechanics evidence. Prior per-exercise sources remain historical; no claim that all exact variations or doses or domestic full texts were revalidated.
